resources.string: Allow notification access so your authorized AI can read notifications from apps you specify, open them, and dismiss clearable notifications. This is separate from allowing Pixels Agent Bridge to send notifications. Android requires confirmation in system settings.
Enable device control, connect this phone, then use its device code and password in Pixels Agent Bridge on your computer.
In Pixels Agent Bridge on your computer, enter this device code and access password. Keep the phone unlocked for screen control.
The device code and password will appear after connecting.
Device control could not start. Reopen Pixels Agent Bridge; if this persists, try updating the application.
Saved settings could not be read. Your settings have been preserved. Try reloading; if this persists, contact support.
Device control permission is missing or disconnected. Enable Pixels Agent Bridge device control in Android settings. If already enabled, switch it off and on again.
Control paused. New remote operations are blocked; running commands and terminals are stopping. Tap Resume control to continue.
Screen locked or off. Unlock the phone to resume screen control.
No network connection. Enable Wi-Fi or mobile data; an active connection will retry automatically.
Not connected. Connect this phone in step 2.
Connection interrupted. Retrying automatically; you can disconnect below.
Disconnecting. Wait for cleanup before connecting again.
Connection failed. Check your network and server settings, then tap Save and connect to retry.
Server connected; remote device channel is unavailable. Check the relay in Server settings.
Ready for a remote connection. Use the device code and password below.
Screen capture is authorized for this session.
Screen capture needs your approval on this phone. Input control can work without screenshots.
Could not save settings. Check the device name and server addresses and try again.
No screenshot yet. Wait a moment and try again.
Android refused the screenshot. This screen may contain protected content.
The screen changed. Inspect it again before performing an action.
The device is busy. Wait for the current action to finish.
The operation could not be completed. Check permissions and inspect the current screen before trying again.
Device channel started; screen control requires accessibility permission.
Android 9 and 10 require screen capture consent for each new session.
Device connection active · disconnect in Pixels Agent Bridge
Check your network and server settings. An interrupted connection retries automatically; if it has stopped, tap Save and connect to retry.
Enabling Pixels Agent Bridge device control allows the service to read screen content and perform input. You can disconnect in the app or disable the service in Android settings.
Refresh the access password for new connections. Existing sessions stay connected.
Dedicated workspace: /workspace. Grant a directory to make its files accessible remotely.
Could not update directory access. Please select the directory again.

Remote APK installation requires your permission to install apps from Pixels Agent Bridge and confirmation in the system installer. Updates preserve app data; uninstalling removes the target app and its data.
Allow notifications to see the remote connection status and its stop action. Permission alone will not start a connection.
Enable the Pixels Agent Bridge accessibility service to observe the screen, tap controls and enter text remotely. Return here after choosing in system settings.
Allow Pixels Agent Bridge to install apps from this source. Each APK installation or removal still uses Android’s system confirmation.
Select a directory for remote file access, or use only Pixels Agent Bridge’ dedicated workspace. You can grant more directories from the home screen later.
Android 9 and 10 need screen capture consent for each capture session. Confirm in the system dialog; control stays paused if it was paused.
Permissions are ready for the current device and file access choice.
Some features need permission. Complete setup to enable them.
Could not complete the previous request. Check app permissions to try again.

Enabled by default. Restores your last requested connection after the first unlock following a reboot or after an app update. A stopped connection stays stopped. Allow autostart and unrestricted background battery use in your phone settings. Force stop and manufacturer restrictions can prevent automatic startup.
Automatic startup was blocked. Tap to open Pixels Agent Bridge and restore your connection.
